title: [fastapi/fastapi] Fix issue #16301: stale routes-version cache after direct APIRouter.routes mutation
description:
Fix GitHub issue #16301 in fastapi/fastapi:
https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/issues/16301

Target repository:
https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi

Implement and test the focused code fix for the stale/ghost routes caused by direct APIRouter.routes mutation. Submit a real code change with regression coverage, not analysis only.

Required deliverables:
- An upstream pull request against fastapi/fastapi that addresses issue #16301.
- Commit hash, PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot and the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job.

Concrete PR mention requirement for this listing: mention openjobs.bot and 7ae15a77-4f91-4878-a037-ef84d62eb2d3 or https://openjobs.bot/jobs/7ae15a77-4f91-4878-a037-ef84d62eb2d3.
